goal.objective: Advance the canonical separated v12 heartbeat from immutable legacy HB29 through state-transition continuity and a task-capable WorkerCoordinator cycle while keeping carrier and worker authority separate and requiring no third-party production dependency.
success_predicates: A bounded v12 carrier transition derives HB30 or a later valid successor into control/heartbeat-carrier-runtime-state.json while control/heartbeat-state.json remains immutable at HB29
The independently admitted WorkerCoordinator observes the successor without carrier-granted execution authority
A real task-capable WorkerCoordinator cycle executes at or after the target carrier epoch; observation-only CARRIER_REFERENCE_ONLY_NO_TASK_EXECUTION state is insufficient for runtime release
State reconstruction passes and no duplicate claim/fence is introduced
The already-bound G18 worker consumes its terminal response and the registry/control-plane release the stale G18 claim/fence
No additional physical machine, external scheduler, hosted process provider, GitHub token, or NON-TV/TVC credential becomes production authority
authority_ceiling: bounded sovereign carrier and worker-runtime activation only

completion.next_authorized_action: The existing #122/#12 StegVerse runtime owner starts or restarts the already-released task-capable scripts/run_worker_runtime.py process on the materialized sovereign node. Its next admitted WorkerCoordinator cycle invokes the already-bound G18 worker, consumes COMPLETED / SOVEREIGN_RUNTIME_STATE_TRANSITION_VERIFIED, releases the G18 claim/fence, and continues downstream.
terminal_when: a task-capable WorkerCoordinator event at HB31 or later is durably observed
the corrected heartbeat transition release validator reports RELEASE_COMPLETE
control/worker-registry.json records SHWP-DURABLE-RUNTIME-ACTIVATION terminal with no active G18 claim/worker binding
control/worker-control-plane-coordination.json no longer lists G18 as an active lease
terminal checkpoint/receipt binds the HB31 continuity evidence and task-capable worker cycle

constraint.machine_observable_completion_condition: events/worker-runtime.jsonl contains a non-observation WorkerCoordinator event at HB31+; corrected transition release becomes RELEASE_COMPLETE; worker registry/control-plane no longer contain an active G18 claim/lease

release_hardening.rule: Observation-only worker evidence may prove carrier continuity but may not satisfy runtime RELEASE_COMPLETE.

superseded_contract_history.reason: The prior handoff correctly observed HB31 continuity but incorrectly allowed observation-only WorkerCoordinator state to satisfy RELEASE_COMPLETE. The stronger release gate now requires task-capable WorkerCoordinator evidence before runtime activation/release can be claimed.
superseded_contract_history.preservation: Git history preserves the HB31 continuity evidence; only the release interpretation is superseded.
